You extract data from Polish and foreign invoices. Return only the fields of the schema.  Rules: - Copy values exactly as printed. Never calculate, correct or complete anything.   If the printed total looks wrong, still return the printed value. - Amounts: string with a dot as decimal separator and no thousands separators, e.g. "14800.00". - Dates: YYYY-MM-DD. - seller = party under "Sprzedawca" / "Supplier"; buyer = party under "Nabywca" / "Customer".   In the text the two headers may stand on one line, followed first by the seller block, then the buyer block. - nip: 10 digits only, no dashes, no "PL" prefix. Foreign VAT IDs (e.g. "DE123456789") go to vat_id, nip stays null. - bank_account: digits only for Polish accounts (26 digits); IBAN without spaces for foreign ones. - If a field is not on the invoice, return null. - Ignore watermark and footer lines ("DEMO", "Generated by ...").

- category: choose exactly one value from the schema enum based on what was bought
  (line descriptions and seller). If none fits or you are unsure, use "other".

parameters.pythonCode:
# n8n Code node "Decide" (Python, Run Once for All Items)
# Routing rules in one place. Input: everything collected so far
# (checks, same_file/same_number, whitelist, fx, category, cost_center, approval_threshold_pln).
# Output adds: gross_pln, status, review_reasons.
#
# status:
#   duplicate     - already in the register (same file, or same seller + number) -> not inserted
#   error         - data is invalid (failed checks) -> stored, nobody can approve it as is
#   needs_review  - data is valid, but a person must decide (Telegram approval)
#   approved      - everything fine, booked automatically

from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal

CENT = Decimal("0.01")


def decide(item):
    gross_raw = (item.get("amounts") or {}).get("gross")
    gross = Decimal(gross_raw) if gross_raw is not None else None
    rate = (item.get("fx") or {}).get("rate")
    if gross is None:
        gross_pln = None                      # unreadable amount -> invoice is an "error" anyway
    elif rate:
        gross_pln = (gross * Decimal(str(rate))).quantize(CENT, ROUND_HALF_UP)
    else:
        gross_pln = gross
    threshold = Decimal(str(item["approval_threshold_pln"]))

    reasons = []
    if (item.get("whitelist") or {}).get("status") == "NIE":
        reasons.append("bank account is not on the VAT white list")
    if item.get("category") in (None, "", "other") or not item.get("cost_center"):
        reasons.append("category not recognised")
    if gross_pln is not None and gross_pln > threshold:
        reasons.append(f"gross {gross_pln} PLN is above the approval threshold {threshold} PLN")
    reasons += [f"warning: {w}" for w in item["checks"]["warnings"]]

    if item.get("same_file") or item.get("same_number"):
        status = "duplicate"
    elif not item["checks"]["ok"]:
        status = "error"
    elif reasons:
        status = "needs_review"
    else:
        status = "approved"

    return {**item, "gross_pln": str(gross_pln) if gross_pln is not None else None, "status": status, "review_reasons": reasons}


return [{"json": decide(i["json"])} for i in _items]

parameters.query:
-- Query of the n8n Postgres node "Save invoice" (Execute Query).
-- Always returns exactly one row: invoice_id, or NULL when a UNIQUE constraint
-- (same file, or same seller + invoice number) already holds this invoice.
-- One row per input item keeps the following "Merge by position" aligned.

WITH ins AS (
    INSERT INTO business.invoices (
        source, source_message_id, file_name, file_sha256,
        seller_tax_id, seller_name, invoice_number,
        issue_date, sale_date, due_date, bank_account,
        currency, net_amount, vat_amount, gross_amount,
        fx_rate, fx_rate_date, fx_table_no, gross_pln,
        whitelist_status, whitelist_request_id, validation_errors,
        category, cost_center, status, approved_by, approved_at,
        extracted
    )
    VALUES (
        'email', $1, $2, $3,
        $4, $5, $6,
        $7::date, $8::date, $9::date, $10,
        $11, $12::numeric, $13::numeric, $14::numeric,
        $15::numeric, $16::date, $17, $18::numeric,
        $19, $20, $21::jsonb,
        $22, $23, $24::text,
        CASE WHEN $24::text = 'approved' THEN 'auto' END,
        CASE WHEN $24::text = 'approved' THEN now() END,
        $25::jsonb
    )
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM ins) AS invoice_id;
